scientific_integrity: The infinite-parameter result is supported by analytic primal and dual semidefinite certificates and explicit uniqueness arguments. A deterministic standard-library verifier checks 124 exact-rational parameter cases and 28 independently normalized examples; finite cases do not replace proof. Historical-literature coverage is incomplete.
scientific_limitations: Exact for unit-row, square invertible real systems with the prescribed signed complete inverse-Gram pattern and fixed iid one-step worst-direction squared-error contraction only. It does not optimize adaptive or multistep error and makes no assertion of admissibility for arbitrary large edge weight.
title: A sharp antagonistic-edge threshold for optimized randomized Kaczmarz sampling on dense inverse-Gram networks
